title: SQL Database Administrator
description:
We’re a game changer that optimizes supply chains of the world’s leading companies with our very own smart software and services.
  
  
Are you an experienced SQL Server database administrator? Are you eager to join a team that forms an essential part of OMP’s solution? Ready to join a place where smart solutions meet human collaboration?
  
  
Then you could be our new Database Administrator. Read on!
  
  
**Your challenge**
As a Database Administrator, you are the go-to person for all database-related challenges within OMP.
  
  
**You Are Responsible For**

* Staying up to date with the latest developments in database technology and integrating them into our products.
* Keeping our internal Oracle and SQL server systems running in top shape.
* Ensuring smooth and solid system performance on our fast-growing Azure cloud.
* Assisting our consultants and developers in writing efficient SQL statements.

**Your team**
As our new Database Administrator, you’ll be part of the Tools and Database team which, in turn, fits into the bigger picture of the Technical Services team. Technical Services equips our teams with the necessary technology, applications, and technical framework for them to do their jobs effectively and securely.
  
  
**About You**
Essential talents and qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Technology or a similar field.
* Strong motivation to learn new technologies.
* Solid experience in writing complex SQL statements and database-stored procedures.
* Experience in installing and maintaining customer-hosted SQL servers or Oracle systems, and managing Azure SQL Database services.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience writing PowerShell.
* Knowledge of alternative, non relational database systems.

**Your future**
We find the perfect intersection of your talents and our evolving needs. Our talent management program supports your personal development and empowers you to build a career in line with your ambitions.
  
  
**Our offer**
At OMP, we offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Continuous learning: Access customized training, coaching programs, and on-the-job development opportunities.
* Flexibility: Flex your schedule with working from home, adaptable hours, and the autonomy to shape your routine.
* Collaborative culture: Cross-team collaboration and creative challenges that encourage you to share knowledge, celebrate wins, and grow together.
* Benefits: An attractive salary package including additional extralegal vacation days, and other competitive benefits.
* Well-being: Thrive in a workplace that supports your physical and mental health by promoting a wide range of facilities and activities like birthday events, sports sessions, in-house coaches and healthy meal options.
* Innovation: Fuel innovation through collaboration, experimentation, and out of the box thinking.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst -Data Engineering
description:
The Medpace Data Engineering team is growing rapidly and is focused on building a data driven culture across the enterprise. The DE team uses data and insights to drive increased strategic and operational efficiencies across the organization. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will hold a highly visible analytical role that requires partnership with staff across the Medpace organization.
  
  
What’s in this for you?
  
  

* Work in a collaborative, fast paced, entrepreneurial, and innovative workplace;
* Gain experience and exposure to advanced BI concepts from data warehousing to AI;

**Responsibilities**
What’s involved?
  
  
We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to add depth to our growing Analytical team in a variety of areas – including SQL, Python, Data Modeling, and Data Warehousing. This role will work in close partnership with the US Data Engineering team to drive enterprise-wide data initiatives to completion.
  
  
An ideal candidate in this role will apply great analytical skills, communication skills, and problem-solving skills to continue developing our analytics & BI capabilities. We are looking for team members who thrive in working with complex data sets, conducting deep data analysis, are intensely curious, and enjoy designing and developing long-term solutions.
  
  
What you bring to the table – and why we need you!
  
  

* Technical Skills – either experience in, or strong desire to learn fundamental technical skills needed to drive Data initiatives (SQL, Python, Dimensional Modeling, etc.);
* Communication Skills - Partner with other data engineers to implement data architecture and design, to support complex analysis;
* Analytical Skills - Conduct complex analysis and proactively identify key business insights to assist departmental decision making.
* Data Visualization skills - Designing and developing key metrics, reports, and dashboards to drive insights and business decisions to improve performance and reduce costs;

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Life Science, Computer Science, or Related Degree;
* 0-5 years of experience in business intelligence or data engineering – advanced SQL and Python preferred;
* Strong analytical and communication skills;
* Excellent organization skills and the ability to work independently.

**Medpace Overview**
Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.
  
  
**Why Medpace?**
When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
***Purpose-Driven Work***




+ Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

***Collaborative Culture***




+ Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

***Continuous Growth & Development***




+ Office based environment with on-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

**Other Employee Benefits**




+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
+ Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
+ Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
+ Company-sponsored social events

*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*
**What To Expect Next**
A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: Sr. Symfony Engineer  - PHP (Remote, Full-Time) [AR024]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity — it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Senior PHP/Symfony Engineer, you will take hands-on ownership of backend development within a mature Symfony platform that manages marketing and revenue data for enterprise customers. The core application currently runs on Symfony 6.1, with an upgrade to Symfony 7 planned, alongside an Angular front end and TypeScript and Python AI agent microservices.

  

This is a strongly backend-weighted, senior hands-on engineering role requiring an architect mindset, strong independence and the ability to understand how technical decisions affect the wider system. You will work within a remote, cross-functional product squad alongside engineering, product, QA and DevOps colleagues.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Take ownership of backend development within the core Symfony application, becoming fully independent in delivering work within 2–3 months of joining
  
* Review and critically assess code written by the team and AI tools, challenging proposed approaches and making sure key considerations have been properly addressed
  
* Support the migration from Symfony 6.1 to Symfony 7 by resolving versioning, compatibility and legacy issues currently preventing the upgrade
  
* Improve the application’s performance, scalability and maintainability, making it easier and safer to introduce new functionality
  
* Work across the Angular front end, TypeScript and Python-based AI agent services, collaborating with DevOps where backend changes impact other areas of the system
  
* Be comfortable reading and understanding the Angular/TypeScript codebase, even though the role is primarily backend focused. Strong front-end development experience is not required
  
* Understand the wider impact of technical decisions across Symfony, Angular and AI services, while spotting gaps or issues in both human-written and AI-generated code
  
* Question existing approaches, identify root causes and look for better ways of building things rather than simply completing assigned tickets
  
* Deliver thoughtful, maintainable solutions within a legacy codebase while maintaining a consistent pace of delivery
  
* Work with a high level of autonomy and ownership while collaborating effectively with a remote, cross-functional team
  
* Follow SOC 2, PII and security requirements consistently and without exception
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 8+ years of commercial software engineering experience, including at least 5 years working with PHP
  
* 7+ years of Expert-level PHP development experience
  
* 3+ years of recent commercial experience with Symfony 6.x/7 at Advanced level. Strong senior-level Laravel experience may be considered where the experience is clearly transferable and the candidate has a good understanding of the differences between Laravel and Symfony
  
* 4+ years of Advanced experience in backend architecture, system design and scalability
  
* 2+ years of Advanced experience using AI development tools critically, including reviewing, validating and challenging AI-generated code rather than accepting it without question
  
* 5+ years of Advanced MySQL experience, including database schema design and query optimisation. Equivalent depth of experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database may also be considered
  
* At least 1 year of experience working with or understanding Angular/TypeScript. Experience with React or Vue using TypeScript may also be considered, but some front-end exposure is essential
  
* 3+ years of Advanced experience with automated testing using PHPUnit. Experience with Pest or another equivalent PHP testing framework may also be considered
  
* At least 1 year of Intermediate experience working on framework upgrades and modernising legacy codebases. Experience with major-version upgrades or significant refactoring in other large PHP applications may be considered
  
* 2+ years of Intermediate AWS experience. Equivalent experience with Azure or GCP may also be considered
  
* Fluent written and spoken English
  
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a remote environment
  
* Ability to work UK hours
  
* Ability to successfully complete strict background checks and adhere to PII and data protection requirements
  
* Strong self-sufficiency, with the ability to operate independently and without handholding after 2–3 months, while continuing to collaborate effectively with the wider team
  
* A hands-on engineering approach combined with an architectural mindset, with the ability to understand how and why the wider system works rather than focusing only on writing code
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* 2+ years of Intermediate CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions; GitLab CI, Jenkins or Azure DevOps are suitable alternatives
  
* Basic experience with Amazon Redshift or data warehousing; Snowflake or BigQuery may be considered.
  
* Azure exposure alongside AWS
  
* Previous project leadership experience
  
* Previous mentoring and technical leadership experience with other engineers

  Serve as the single point of contact (SPOC) for Oracle functional support, covering the end-to-end Manufacturing and Supply Chain lifecycle.

  Own the health, stability, and continuous optimization of the ERP landscape supporting a high-volume manufacturing plant.

  Provide expert support for formulas, recipes, and batch production execution.

  Manage inspection protocols, quality collection plans, and non-conformance tracking.

  Drive sub inventory accuracy, material transfers, and physical inventory / cycle-count processes.

  Provide end-to-end functional ownership of Purchasing and iProcurement.
* **Order-to-Cash (O2C):**
  Support sales orders, shipping execution, and customer fulfilment processes.

  Support dispatch planning, route/vehicle assignment, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery processes; ensure integration with order fulfilment and invoicing.

  Build and interpret dashboards for production, inventory, quality, and fulfilment KPIs to support operational decision-making.
* **Enterprise Asset Management (EAM):**
  Support plant maintenance, asset tracking, and preventive-maintenance scheduling.

Secondary Skill Requirements (Finance & Costing)

* **Oracle Costing:**
  Strong functional understanding of OPM/Standard costing, including overhead absorption, WIP valuation, and month-end cost freezes.
* **Finance integration:**
  Understand the accounting impact of SCM transactions to ensure accurate automated entries to Payables (AP), Receivables (AR), and the General Ledger (GL).
* **Period close:**
  Partner with SCM and Finance teams to enable timely month-end close and reconciliations.

Technical & Regional Requirements

* **SQL proficiency:**
  Query back-end tables independently for rapid troubleshooting and data reconciliation.
* **Indian statutory knowledge:**
  Familiarity with GST, e-way bills, and TDS configurations relevant to manufacturing and procurement.
* **Incident leadership:**
  Manage the full support ticket lifecycle independently in a fast-paced plant environment.

* Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition.

* Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Industry Experience: Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments such as food manufacturing, pharma, or CPG

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to MES platforms such as TrakSYS or similar, and integration patterns with SAP or other enterprise systems
* GCP certification
* Background in Mathematics or Statistics

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Executive - Commercial Enablement
description:
Data Engineer – Commercial Enablement
   

  

 Mumbai \| 2–4 years experience \| \[Hybrid, X days a week in office / On\-site]
   

  

 We're the Commercial Enablement team at a large pharmaceutical company in India. We build and run the digital products our field force uses every day : sales performance tracking, incentive calculations, distributor and channel platforms, and the reporting that leadership looks at every week.
   

  

 All of it runs on data, and we need people to build and look after that data layer properly.
   

  

 What the job is
   

  

 You'll build the pipelines that pull data from our sales, CRM, HR and external market sources, clean it up, model it, and make it available to dashboards and applications. Then you'll keep them running. This isn't a project role where you hand over and move on. You'll own what you build once it's in production.
   

  

 You'll sit inside the product team, not in a central IT function. That means you'll hear directly from the people using the numbers, you'll be part of the discussion when requirements are set, and you'll know when something you built is being used in a leadership review.
   

  

 What you'll own :
   

  

* Building and maintaining ingestion and transformation pipelines across multiple source systems
* Handling the messy stuff : late data, backdated corrections, restated months, duplicates
* Working on the commercial data model, including keeping history accurate when sales territories, managers, products or reporting lines change
* Putting data quality checks, monitoring and alerts in place so problems are caught before they reach a payout or a leadership review
* Troubleshooting when something breaks or two numbers don't match, finding the root cause, and fixing it properly
* Writing things down so the next person can understand them


 What you'll get exposure to as you grow :
   

  

* Tuning queries and storage as we scale from a regional rollout to all of India
* Moving legacy data onto our cloud platform
* Reviewing what our vendors build and pushing back when it isn't good enough
* Working with our IT team on infrastructure, security and access


 Owning pipelines in production means occasionally being the person who looks at a failure outside normal hours, usually around month\-end or payout cycles. \[Adjust or remove based on actual support arrangement.]
   

  

 Who we're looking for
   

  

 2 to 4 years working with data, including at least a year of hands\-on work building or maintaining production pipelines that people depend on. You've worked with large datasets and you've had to make something faster or more reliable.
   

  

 You don't need an engineering degree. Some of the best people we've come across in this space started in commerce, finance or economics and moved into data through certifications or simply by doing the work. If you've built real pipelines, we'd like to hear from you.
   

  

 You may be a good fit if :
   

  

* You started on the business side (sales analytics, inventory, ERP) and moved into data engineering
* You're a data analyst or data scientist who ended up building the pipelines behind your own work and found you liked that part more
* You're a data engineer who wants to be closer to the business and the people using your work


 Must have :
   

  

* Strong SQL. Comfortable with window functions and CTEs, and able to work out why a query is slow
* Python for transformation and validation work
* Experience building and running batch pipelines in production
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud data platform. We don't mind which one
* A working understanding of dimensional modelling : star schemas, grain, slowly changing dimensions
* Git, and some familiarity with testing and deploying changes to data pipelines


 Good to have :
   

  

* Spark or another distributed processing framework
* Experience with an orchestration tool
* Enough experience with a BI tool to build datasets that reports can actually run on
* Streaming pipelines
* Experience in pharma, healthcare, BFSI or another regulated industry
* Some exposure to forecasting or predictive models, so you understand what downstream users need from your data
* Experience migrating legacy systems to the cloud


 The right person is careful about getting numbers right, comfortable telling a stakeholder something isn't ready yet, able to explain a technical problem without jargon, and happy to take real ownership in a small team.
   

  

 What we'd expect
   

  

 In your first three months, get to know how data flows through our systems and take over at least one production pipeline. By six months, have quality checks and monitoring running on everything you own. By the end of your first year, you should be independently owning a meaningful part of the commercial data model and contributing to its rollout across India.
   

  

 A lot of what this team produces ends up in people's incentive payouts and in leadership reviews. When the data is wrong, people notice. We need someone who takes that seriously.

**What You Will Bring**

* Knowledge and some experience in OpenShift by Red Hat;
* Experience with another Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS) solution will also be considered
* Hands on experience using Cloud as a development environment

* Ability and desire to learn new technologies on your own and apply new concepts to problems

* Working with application and infrastructure monitoring
* Experience with or knowledge of JavaScript, Golang, Python, or Shell Scripting
* Experience with or knowledge of technologies AngularJS, React.js, and Vue.js


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at Red Hat**
 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

title: Engineer - AI (Mining Automation)
description:
**Job Description**
 WSP is seeking an Engineer AI (Mining Automation) to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, supporting the delivery of digital and automation solutions for global mining projects. Reporting to the Mining Automation Team Leader, the successful candidate will develop and implement AI\-enabled workflows that improve the way mining, asset, operational, geotechnical, and technical information is processed, connected, analysed, and used for engineering decision\-making.
   

  

 The role combines mining\-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph\-based retrieval. The Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across WSP to develop practical, scalable, traceable, and responsible solutions for mine planning, operations, tailings and water management, asset performance, risk management, and engineering delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**AI and Mining Automation Development**
* Design, develop, and implement AI\-enabled automation solutions for mining engineering and operational workflows.
* Work with mining specialists to identify high\-value automation opportunities and convert technical requirements into practical digital solutions.
* Develop intelligent workflows that integrate geological, geotechnical, mine planning, operational, asset,


 environmental, and risk information.
   

  

* Support the use of generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agent\-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and decision support.
* Create reusable components and scalable solution patterns that can be applied across global mining projects.


**Data Extraction and Document Intelligence**
* Develop automated pipelines to extract information from mining reports, PDFs, scanned documents, drawings, tables, figures, inspection records, and monitoring outputs.
* Apply OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models, and LLM\-based techniques to identify entities, attributes, relationships, measurements, risks, and supporting evidence.
* Implement validation, normalization, exception\-handling, and quality\-control logic to improve the accuracy and consistency of extracted information.
* Maintain traceability between extracted outputs and the relevant source documents, pages, figures, tables, or evidence.


**AI Models and Advanced Analytics**
* Develop, validate, and support deployment of machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification, risk assessment, optimization, and asset insights.
* Apply data science and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from engineering and operational data.
* Evaluate model performance, limitations, and suitability for mining use cases, working with domain experts to confirm engineering relevance.
* Contribute to proof\-of\-concept development and the transition of successful prototypes into maintainable production solutions.


**Knowledge Management and Graph\-Based Intelligence**
* Support the design of structured knowledge models that connect mining assets, technical information, operational data, risks, controls, and engineering evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge graph and semantic data solutions using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent technologies where appropriate.
* Develop graph\-native and hybrid retrieval workflows, including GraphRAG approaches that combine structured graph context with AI models.
* Enable natural\-language access to connected mining knowledge for engineering assistants, analytics tools, and decision\-support applications.
* Support provenance, versioning, evidence linking, and auditability of AI\-generated or graph\-derived outputs.


**Cloud, Data, and Platform Integration**
* Develop and integrate solutions using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI


 Document Intelligence, and related cloud capabilities, where applicable.
   

  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, APIs, connectors, and services that integrate AI workflows with engineering platforms and enterprise data environments.
* Contribute to deployment, monitoring, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement of production AI applications.
* Support MLOps, prompt and model evaluation, access control, data security, and responsible AI practices.


**Global Project Delivery and Collaboration**
* Work as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team to support multidisciplinary mining assignments delivered across WSP's global business.
* Collaborate with the Mining Automation Team Leader, mining engineers, geotechnical specialists, tailings


 practitioners, data scientists, software developers, and digital teams.
   

  

* Engage with project and domain teams to understand technical context, refine use cases, review outputs, and align solutions with project requirements.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Prepare solution documentation, specifications, test records, user guidance, and knowledge\-transfer materials.
* Contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, lessons learned, innovation initiatives, and capability


 development within the team.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mining Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence,


 Software Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline.
   

  

**Technical Experience And Skills**
* Experience developing AI, machine learning, automation, data analytics, or document intelligence solutions in


 mining, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, or asset\-intensive environments.
   

  

* Proficiency in Python and experience with relevant AI, data science, or machine learning libraries and frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, or generative AI application development.
* Knowledge of data engineering concepts, ETL or ELT pipelines, APIs, structured and unstructured data processing, and system integration.
* Experience with OCR, document processing, computer vision, layout analysis, or multimodal AI techniques.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure\-based AI and data services.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
We are hiring Senior / Lead Engineers to design, build, and scale robust, production\-grade data and platform systems for a product portfolio within Blenheim. This is a hands\-on engineering role where you will own complex problem areas end\-to\-end, influence system architecture, mentor engineers, and deliver scalable solutions in a fast\-growing, product\-led environment.
   

  

 If you enjoy working with ambiguity, building platforms from the ground up, and shipping real business impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**About Blenheim Chalcot:**
 Blenheim Chalcot India is part of Blenheim Chalcot, a global venture builder headquartered in London. With over 26 years of innovation, we've been at the forefront of creating some of the most groundbreaking GenAI\-enabled companies. Our ventures lead the charge in digital disruption across a spectrum of industries, from FinTech to EdTech, GovTech to Media, and beyond. Our global presence spans the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with a portfolio that employs over 3,000 individuals, manages assets exceeding £1\.8 billion, and boasts total portfolio sales of over £500 million.
   

  

**The Role:**
 As a Senior / Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering scalable systems across core platforms. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams in Mumbai and London, helping shape technical direction while remaining hands\-on.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 Successful candidates will take a leading role within our Engineering Centre of Excellence in Mumbai, with day to day responsibilities which will include.
   

  

* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the planning and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Provide technical guidance and expertise to the team, promoting best practices in engineering.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Implement and maintain ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes using scalable pipelines and data architecture.
* Ensure data integrity and quality across various data sources.
* Support data\-driven decision\-making by providing clean, reliable, and timely data.
* Design, develop, and maintain the data models used by ML Engineers, Data Analysts and Data Scientists to access data.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and trends.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and drive continuous improvement in operations.
* Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and best practices in engineering.


**About You:**
 We are seeking to onboard candidates with a track record of leading complex delivery, demonstrating technical depth and pragmatic leadership. You’re hands‑on when it matters, coach others effectively, and make clear design trade‑offs that improve customer and business outcomes. You communicate crisply, collaborate across functions, and keep teams focused on the few things that move the needle.
   

  

**The Ideal Candidate:**
* Professional experience in full\-stack software engineering with evidence of architecting and delivering production systems at scale.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing engineers and raising code quality standards.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in engineering, such as Python or Java.
* Extensive experience with database systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases.
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud data platforms like AWS or Azure (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Data Factory, Azure Synapse, etc.).
* Experience with CI/CD practices for data solutions.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude etc) and building AI\-enabled features (e.g., LLMs, automation workflows, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted development) to enhance product capabilities and engineering productivity.
* Proven ability to take ownership over outputs and drive complex data projects to completion.
* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguous, problem\-solving environments.
* Strong evidence of teamwork and successful cross\-functional delivery; including particularly with customers, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.


 Behaviours that we look for
   

  

* Rigorous problem\-solving and systems thinking. Breaks down complex problems, evaluates multiple approaches, and designs scalable, maintainable architectures.
* Clean, performant, and secure code. Chooses suitable data structures, writes readable \& defensive code, and bakes in performance and security from the start.
* Test\-first and observable engineering. Designs for testability, automates meaningful unit/integration tests, and implements robust logging, metrics, and monitoring.
* Production and operations excellence. Understands CI/CD, infrastructure and cost drivers, engineers for reliable development, resilience, and fast recovery.
* Data\-driven, outcome\-focused decisions. Validates ideas with data, plans for schema evaluation, and aligns features with real user impact.


 Process \- We have a rigorous, but streamlined recruitment process, which respects the time of candidates and portfolio companies alike. This process starts with a 15\-minute call with our Talent Acquisition team and a member of the Engineering Centre of Excellence, followed by further interviews with the Engineering Centre of Excellence team.
   

  

 Please note that our roles are primarily office based, with modern and well\-connected office locations in both Andheri East and Navi Mumbai.

**Position Purpose:** 
 We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient candidate to design, develop, and implement advanced data visualization solutions and collaborative ecosystem frameworks within the TPRM function. The successful candidate will act as a vital bridge between technical data engineering and functional business decision\-making. Candidate will leverage Power BI to provide actionable insights into operational performance and use SharePoint to optimize enterprise\-wide information management and workflow automation. This role requires a strategic thinker capable of managing complex stakeholder requirements and delivering self\-sufficient, high\-impact digital solutions to drive operational excellence in a highly regulated environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Data Visualization \& Business Intelligence (Power BI focus):
* End\-to\-End Development: Lead the design, development and deployment of complex, scalable and high\-performance Power BI dashboards to monitor BAU (Business\-as\-Usual) operational metrics.
* Advanced Data Modeling: Architect sophisticated Data Models using DAX and Power Query/M to transform raw operational data into meaningful business intelligence.
* Data Optimization: Collaborate with Data Engineers to optimize data sources (SQL, Data Lakes, Cloud environments) to ensure seamless, high\-speed reporting.
* Executive Storytelling: Translate complex operational datasets into intuitive visual stories and high\-level executive summaries that enable functional heads to make rapid, data\-driven decisions.
* Collaboration \& Workflow Automation (SharePoint focus):
* Ecosystem Management: Design and manage enterprise\-grade SharePoint environments (On\-premises) to facilitate seamless team collaboration and centralized information access.
* Security \& Lifecycle Management: Manage permissions, security protocols and the full lifecycle management of collaborative sites and critical documentation.


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Change Management \& Transition Support:
* Operational Readiness: Support the Change Management team in transitioning new applications or processes from project phase to BAU by establishing the necessary reporting frameworks and documentation hubs.
* Knowledge Transfer: Facilitate the seamless adoption of new tools or processes by designing intuitive SharePoint training repositories and automated guidance workflows.
* Functional Collaboration:
* Requirement Gathering: Participate in functional requirement workshops to translate complex business needs into technical specifications.
* Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of digital tools and processes within the CIB ITO landscape to enhance overall departmental efficiency.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Competencies**
* Power BI Mastery: Expert\-level proficiency in DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling and advanced visualization techniques.
* SharePoint Ecosystem: Expert knowledge of SharePoint Online, Site Architecture and advanced configuration.
* Data Fundamentals: Strong command of SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
* Integration: Experience integrating Power BI/SharePoint with other enterprise tools (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Azure DevOps, or ERP systems).


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Analytical Thinking: Exceptional ability to dissect complex operational problems and design data\-driven solutions.
* Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholder expectations and navigate a complex organizational matrix.
* Communication Skills: Ability to communicate intricate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical business audiences and produce polished, professional digital content.
* Operational Autonomy: High degree of self\-sufficiency to drive projects from conception to completion within a functional setting.


**Specific Qualifications**
* Microsoft Certifications (e.g., PL\-300: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, or Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert).
* Experience working within a highly regulated industry (e.g., Banking, Insurance, or FinTech).
* Knowledge of Azure Data services (Azure SQL, Data Factory).
* 6\+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics and/or Business Intelligence.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Science, Business Analytics or a related field.


**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. title: Omnesys Platform Lead
description:
Position Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
 **Senior Infrastructure \& Specialist** 
 to join our India Equities Technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the high availability, reliability, and performance of our mission\-critical, high\-frequency trading (HFT) infrastructure and applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in capital markets, hands\-on expertise in Linux/Unix environments, deep knowledge of the FIX protocol, and a proven track record of supporting high\-touch trading desks, Direct Market Access (DMA), and algorithmic trading platforms. You will bridge the gap between infrastructure operations, development teams, and business stakeholders to maintain a seamless trading environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Infrastructure \& Environment Management
* Environment Maintenance: Manage and maintain multi\-tier UAT and Production environments, ensuring system stability, configuration consistency, and readiness for daily trading activities.
* Batch Scheduling \& Automation: Design, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot batch jobs using Autosys to automate critical operational workflows and data processing.
* System Operations: Perform daily Start of Day (SOD) and End of Day (EOD) activities on Linux systems to guarantee environment availability for live trading.
* Database Support: Query and manage relational databases (SQL, Postgres, Oracle) to fetch data, analyze table partitions, and support data warehousing requirements.
* Application \& Connectivity Support
* FIX Connectivity Management: Lead the functional enhancement, configuration, and monitoring of the FIX connectivity platform. Manage client onboarding, UAT testing, and certification of FIX algos.
* Trading Desk Support: Provide on\-floor L1/L2 production support to high\-touch trading desks for equities, futures, and options, as well as DMA and algorithmic trading desks.
* Exchange Connectivity: Coordinate and execute exchange connectivity tasks, including uploading exchange files, margin/position files, and participating in regular exchange mock trading sessions (e.g., NSE/BSE).
* Vendor \& Developer Collaboration: Act as the primary technical liaison with third\-party application vendors (e.g., Omnesys, Traderpath) and internal development teams to resolve complex application bugs and deploy backend fixes.
* Monitoring, Incident \& Change Management
* Proactive Monitoring: Utilize enterprise monitoring tools such as ITRS Geneos to track system health, latency, and connectivity, proactively addressing alerts before they impact the business.
* Incident Resolution: Own and manage production incidents from detection through to resolution. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and raise/track tickets in ServiceNow and Jira.
* Change \& Release Management: Schedule, coordinate, and deploy production changes, software packages, and drivers on servers during non\-market hours, adhering to strict change control policies.
* Regulatory Reporting: Ensure timely processing and transfer of operational and transaction files (e.g., OTR files) to regulatory bodies (e.g., SEBI) and clients.


**Required Technical Skills \& Qualifications**
 Experience \& Education
   

  

* Experience: Minimum of 7\+ years of experience in production support, application support, or infrastructure operations within the Capital Markets / Investment Banking domain.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electronics \& Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related technical field).


 Technical Competencies
   

  

* Operating Systems: Strong administration and troubleshooting skills in Linux/Unix and Windows environments.
* Scripting: Proficiency in Unix Shell Scripting for task automation, log analysis, and data extraction.
* Protocols: Deep understanding of FIX Protocols (session and application levels) and FIX configuration.
* Databases: Solid experience writing SQL queries and working with Postgres, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Tools \& Applications:
+ Scheduling: Autosys
+ Monitoring: ITRS Geneos
+ Ticketing/Collaboration: ServiceNow, Jira
+ Trading Applications: Experience with trading platforms (e.g., Omnesys, Traderpath, Gatelab HFT, Bloomberg) is highly desirable.


 Soft Skills \& Domain Knowledge
   

  
+ Domain Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of capital markets, equity/derivatives trading lifecycles, and high\-frequency trading (HFT) concepts.
+ Stakeholder Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including Institutional Sales, Execution Traders, QA, Compliance, and external vendors.
+ Problem\-Solving: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to perform under pressure during live market hours.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer
 



 Location: Mumbai, India (in office 5 days a week)
 



  




 Position Summary
 
 This is a founding engineering role at the center of our client's AI strategy. Our client is a global investment research, analytics, and accounting firm that serves private equity funds, family offices, credit and hedge funds, investment banks, and corporates across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific. The role follows the Forward Deployed Engineer model: hands\-on technical leaders who embed with the business, own delivery end to end, and take full ownership of the outcomes they ship.
 



 The mandate unfolds in two stages. In the first, you will embed with the firm's internal investment, diligence, portfolio monitoring, and accounting teams to find the highest\-value AI and automation opportunities in its own delivery model and ship them into production. The role reports up to the CEO, with access to senior leadership on a daily basis, the right candidate should have excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
 



 In the second, you will take proven capabilities into the portfolio companies of the firm's private equity and family office clients. These are mid\-market operating businesses whose finance and operations functions often run on fragmented systems, manual reporting, and limited internal technical resources. Working with portfolio company CFOs, controllers, and operating teams, and alongside the sponsor's operating partners, you will design and deliver solutions that improve reporting quality, operational efficiency, and visibility for both management and ownership.
 



 You will design, build, and deliver full\-stack solutions and the AI\-ready data foundations beneath them. The goal is to turn manual, spreadsheet\-based processes into automated, standardized, and auditable systems that professionals and AI agents can both rely on.
 



 The position calls for someone equally comfortable walking a portfolio company controller through a close process, presenting to a sponsor's operating partner, and building the data model, integration, and application that will transform both.
 


 What Success Looks Like
 
 In the first 12 months, you will have:
 


* Shipped multiple production AI solutions embedded in the firm's core delivery workflows.
* Established reusable data, integration, and governance patterns that speed up every initiative that follows.
* Led the firm's first portfolio company deployments from scoping through adoption, with measurable improvements in reporting timelines, data quality, or operating efficiency.
* Earned recognition as a trusted technical authority with the firm's senior leadership, its sponsor clients, and portfolio company management teams.



 This is a highly visible role with a direct line to senior leadership..
 


 Primary ResponsibilitiesBusiness Discovery \& Requirements (≈25%)
 * Partner with the firm's VPs, Associates, and Analysts, and with portfolio company finance and operations teams, to understand business needs and document current\-state processes, calculation logic, systems, and data sources.
* Work with sponsor operating partners and portfolio company leadership to identify where automation and AI will have the greatest effect on value creation priorities.
* Translate business processes into clear technical requirements and target\-state designs.
* Facilitate working sessions and process walkthroughs to validate findings, resolve inconsistencies in how metrics are defined, and align stakeholders on standardized definitions.
* Act as a trusted advisor to management teams and sponsors on what automation can realistically deliver, and in what order.
* Tailor each portfolio company solution to what discovery uncovers, rather than to a predefined catalog of offerings.


 Solution Architecture, Design \& Delivery (≈50%)
 * Architect AI\-ready data foundations that unify portfolio company data across ERP and accounting systems, CRM, billing, payroll, inventory, and other operational platforms. Deliver them as clean, governed data models and reporting layers.
* Design and build automation and AI\-enabled solutions across the portfolio company finance function.
* Support the integration of add\-on acquisitions by consolidating data across disparate systems and standardizing charts of accounts and reporting definitions.
* Build LLM\- and agent\-based applications where they add value, including document extraction, variance commentary, report drafting, and exception monitoring, using the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs and related tooling.
* Build on the firm's initial platform stack of Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and Power BI, and evaluate alternative platforms and vendor solutions where appropriate.
* Work hands\-on to prototype and ship automated replacements for manual processes, starting with the highest\-volume, highest\-risk workflows.
* Deliver solutions inside portfolio company environments and in line with each company's security, access, and data\-handling policies.
* Build evaluation frameworks that measure solution quality against workflow\-specific benchmarks, such as close cycle time, reconciliation breaks, reporting accuracy, and reviewer override rates.
* Establish reusable components, integration templates, and deployment playbooks so that each new portfolio company is faster to onboard than the last, and maintain data lineage from source system to final report.


 Governance, Enablement \& Client Development (≈25%)
 * Design human\-in\-the\-loop review workflows, source traceability, audit trails, and exception handling so that every output can withstand management, board, lender, and audit scrutiny.
* Uphold the firm's AI governance framework, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001 aligned controls and the requirement that client data never be used to train third\-party models.
* Train portfolio company finance teams and the firm's own professionals in effective and responsible use of the solutions delivered, and support change management as manual processes are retired.
* Take part in meetings with sponsors and portfolio company management in the United States, Europe, and the Middle East, and support demonstrations, proposals, and expansion across a sponsor's portfolio.
* Track and communicate progress to senior leadership and sponsor clients, identify data quality and control gaps, and define what it will take to close them.
* Help shape technical hiring and standards as the practice grows.


 RequirementsEducation \& Certifications
 * Bachelor's degree required.
* A concentration in computer science, engineering, data science, finance, accounting, or a related field preferred.
* A CFA, CA, MBA, or master's degree in a technical discipline preferred.


 Professional Experience
 * 4\+ years of relevant experience in software, data, or ML engineering, or in finance, consulting, KPO, or investment roles with significant hands\-on technical responsibility, required.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience working with messy, real\-world financial and operational data, required.
* Experience integrating with or extracting data from ERP and accounting systems, such as NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, or Tally, required.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying applications powered by large language models, including retrieval, structured extraction, or agent\-based workflows, required. Production experience preferred.
* Working familiarity with modern AI and data platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Power BI, Databricks, OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and vector databases, with the ability to evaluate alternatives.
* Working knowledge of corporate finance and accounting workflows, such as month\-end close, financial statement preparation, FP\&A, cash flow forecasting, and lender reporting.
* Exposure to private equity\-backed or family office\-owned companies, value creation initiatives, or post\-acquisition integration preferred.
* Experience delivering for international clients from India, and willingness to work with partial overlap with US and European business hours, preferred.
* Familiarity with data governance, auditability, and confidentiality requirements in high\-stakes environments.


 Competencies \& Attributes
 * **Builder's instinct under ambiguity.** 
 You measure progress in working software, not slides, and you can turn a vague business problem into a working prototype within weeks.
* **Operator empathy.** 
 You understand that portfolio company finance teams are stretched thin. You design solutions that reduce their workload rather than add to it, and you earn adoption by sitting with users.
* **Platform mindset.** 
 You treat every portfolio company as a chance to make the next one faster. You build patterns, not one\-off solutions.
* **Executive presence.** 
 You can sit across from a portfolio company CFO or a sponsor's operating partner, ask the right questions, push back when necessary, and earn trust.
* **Intellectual honesty about AI.** 
 You know what current models can and cannot do, you design around their limitations, and you do not confuse a compelling demonstration with production reliability.
* **Commitment to confidentiality.** 
 You treat client data security and governance as non\-negotiable.
* **Ownership and autonomy.** 
 You are comfortable acting as the first technical hire, setting direction, and being accountable for outcomes.


 What We Offer
 * **Founding ownership.** 
 You will be the first technical hire for a new practice, with direct exposure to senior leadership and the autonomy to set technical direction from day one.
* **Global client exposure.** 
 You will work directly with international sponsors, family offices, and portfolio company management teams across the US, Europe, and the Middle East.
* **A clear growth path.** 
 This role is designed to grow into leadership of the firm's AI engineering practice as it scales.
* **Investment in your development.** 
 Structured training, mentorship from leaders with bulge\-bracket and institutional experience, and support for relevant certifications.
* **Comprehensive health coverage** 
 for you and your dependents.
* **Competitive Compensation** 
 package.

title: Forward Deploy Engineer, Aladdin Data, Associate
description:
**About This Role**
**About the Role**
 BlackRock's Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) is the firm's strategic foundation for how data products are built, governed, and consumed at scale, powering investment decisions, risk analytics, and operational workflows across the firm and its global client base.
   

  

 Data Platform as a Service (DPaaS) is a core capability within EDP, purpose\-built to make data product creation fast, reliable, and repeatable. Whether a team is onboarding a new market data feed, publishing a risk dataset, or operationalizing a model output, DPaaS provides the infrastructure, tooling, and guided experience to take a raw data source and turn it into a trusted, production\-grade data product. Teams get acquisition, ingestion, transformation, quality validation, and governance without having to build any of it themselves.
   

  

**Why This Role is Exciting**
 Most engineers either build platforms or use them. As a Forward Deploy Engineer on the DPaaS team, you do both. You will deploy by embedding directly with teams across the firm, bringing their data products to life and solving real problems that only surface when a platform meets production data. You will build by developing solutions that fill gaps and make it easier for teams to create and publish data products on EDP. You will be at the frontier of how BlackRock thinks about data products, working with real users, influencing what gets built next, and seeing your work in production quickly across a wide range of data domains.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Forward Deployment \& Data Product Onboarding
* Embed directly with partner engineering and data teams to drive end\-to\-end data product onboarding onto DPaaS, from source configuration through to production
* Work hands\-on with teams to define data product structure including schema, ownership, SLAs, quality expectations, and governance attributes
* Support onboarding of both structured and unstructured data products, adapting approaches to fit the nature of the data
* Troubleshoot onboarding failures across infrastructure, pipeline, and data layers in real time
* Run technical onboarding sessions and workshops tailored to each team's data product needs
* Enable partner teams to self\-serve on data product creation over time, reducing dependency on FDE support
* Solution Development \& Platform Contribution
* Develop reusable data product accelerators including pipeline templates, configuration generators, and schema mapping utilities
* Build custom acquisition connectors, ingestion templates, and transformation scaffolding for both structured and unstructured data
* Contribute to core DPaaS platform engineering efforts including new feature development and framework improvements
* Build and maintain data product accelerators and onboarding utilities that become reusable assets across the platform

You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality work while embracing increased ambiguity. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills within our Technology Consulting practice to provide exceptional client support, utilizing a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using reflection to enhance your strengths and address development areas.

* Analyzing client requirements to design and implement SAP data management and analytics solutions
* Developing data models and performing complex data analysis to support data\-driven decision\-making
* Creating visualizations and reports using SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence
* Collaborating with clients to optimize data management processes and enhance data quality
* Providing training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools

These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Quantitative Finance (QF) is part of the Corporate Treasury function, which is a part of the Chief Financial Officer organization. The QF team develops analytical solutions using complex quantitative and financial methodologies to measure value and risk. These analytics are executed on a high\-performance, computational environment utilizing over 23,000 cores and executing 115,000 jobs per day. **Job Description\***
 This role requires strong critical thinking skills to address complex challenges facing the company and financial services industry, with an emphasis on attention to detail, collaboration, and effective communication.
   

  

 Treasury provides an opportunity to gain broad knowledge about the company and its many businesses. Your day\-to\-day experience will be varied and challenging and provide hands\-on responsibilities and opportunities to expand your expertise across multiple disciplines within Treasury and Quantitative Finance.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Support production analytical and reporting execution by monitoring critical processes, investigating issues, coordinating remediation activities, and ensuring operational stability.
* Design, develop, and enhance analytical reporting and forecasting solutions supporting Treasury and market risk activities.
* Drive platform modernization, software transformation, and legacy application decommissioning efforts.
* Utilize automation, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytics technologies to improve efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.
* Collaborate with business, technology, compliance, risk, and global stakeholders to gather requirements, deliver solutions, and support successful execution and adoption of strategic initiatives.
* Produce and maintain technical and business documentation supporting solution implementation, governance, and operational readiness.
* Improve data transparency, traceability, documentation, and governance across internal and external data ecosystems.

title: Analyst – Automation & Business Analysis
description:
**Main Purpose**
 This role is the embedded business\-facing BI engineer \& automation partner for all functions including Finance in Mumbai GCC. Role holder is expected to be aware of finance the way the FP\&A \& Accounting equivalent role does and works the requirements bottleneck that slows delivery. It also owns the operational KPI framework — SLA tracking and the broader business\-led portfolio the site is taking over from central digitization — and automates it so the Site Head has real\-time, trustworthy visibility without manual reporting. Forward\-deployed engineer approach, not a downstream report\-builder, sits with the site team, close to the business problem, iterating fast, builds fast against real operational questions, with the central platform / digitization team for complex builds / data engineering.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the BI layer end\-to\-end for the Mumbai GCC: build, iterate, and maintain dashboards and reporting (Tableau/Sigma) against live business questions, not static specs.
* Close the true bottleneck in the program — requirement definition — by working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with region and functional teams to scope what's actually needed before it's built.
* Partner with the central digitization team on data engineering, security, and architecture governance for anything beyond the BI layer — escalate complex builds rather than solving them solo.
* Drive quality and adoption of self\-serve analytics locally, reducing manual reporting and dependency on the shared services pool for day\-to\-day reporting asks.
* Feed a consistent view of regional KPIs and data definitions back into the global framework, keeping Africa aligned with other regions/functions without slowing down local delivery.
* Gather and translate business requirements directly, rather than waiting on requests routed through central digitization.
* Own the KPI framework for the region (incl. SLA tracking), define what good performance looks like, and automate measurement in Tableau/Sigma.
* Lead steady‑state automation for finance processes (Accounting, Treasury, Controlling, FP\&A) once projects transition from central digitization.
* Build and maintain BI dashboards end‑to‑end, iterating against live business questions rather than static specs.
* Ensure KPI and data definitions stay aligned globally while delivering fast, locally relevant solutions.


**Requirements:**
* 5 to 7 years of experience in BI/analytics engineering, with a track record of dashboards used in real business decisions — not just technical delivery.
* Finance diploma/degree will be a plus.
* Hands\-on with Tableau or Sigma, and strong SQL — comfortable modeling data, not just visualizing it.
* Databricks awareness is a strong plus.
* Aware of finance and how FP\&A/Accounting stakeholders think about numbers — able to hold a real conversation on what a metric means and why it matters, similar in depth to the FP\&A \& Accounting\-facing role.
* Comfortable working with financial/operational data and translating it into KPIs finance and site leadership actually use.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, embedded within a business team, rather than inside a central delivery queue.

**Position Purpose**
* Joining the Data Office IT Payment Services is a direct contribution to the Data strategy of Payment Services, working closely with the DCIO. You will evolve at the heart of a stimulating environment, at the intersection of regulatory, technological and business data\-related challenges. You will take part in leading projects (data asset documentation, data flow reliability, Data architecture evolution, etc.), and will be recognized as an internal expert on the quality and governance of Payment Services data. If you recognize yourself in this profile and wish to shape the excellence and reliability of data for Payment Services and its clients, join us!
* Main mission of Data office is to ensure the quality, security, compliance, traceability, performance and continuity of data across the entire Payment Services Information System. The integrated Data Officer in this team directly contributes to this mission within the context of strengthening IT PS's Data Management governance.
* In this context, the Data Office IT PS operates according to 2 major axes:
* Compliance \& protection: adherence to regulatory standards (GDPR, internal governance policies) and assurance of data protection (security, access management and traceability);
* Data quality: monitoring and continuous improvement of the quality and reliability of data, including through regular IT deliverable checks and contributing to the enhancement of business data quality.
* Missions of the Data Office IT Payment Services team:
* Governance \& Compliance: Deployment of the data governance framework (charters, policies and processes) to ensure the compliance of the data ecosystem with internal regulations and standards. The team defines and monitors data management KPIs, ensures the application of protection policies (confidentiality, access) and contributes to the governance of data\-related control plans. She notably chairs a Data Governance Committee to ensure alignment of data assets with IT PS's Data Management strategy. A data governance and compliance dashboard for Data Management maturity is regularly presented to the IT PS Management.
* Data Architecture \& Projects: The team ensures alignment of data models with business needs and Group standards, and implements full traceability of data and data flows (data lineage). She supports projects in the Data areas (compliance, data model, data dictionaries, quality and strengthening of data security, etc.). The Data Office IT PS plays a cross\-functional coordination role between business requirements, technical requirements and regulatory obligations in order to achieve quality and compliance objectives.
* Support and assistance: The team trains and raises awareness among staff on tools and best practices (e.g. Data Management tools, data dictionary, flow mapping, compliance with quality and security standards, Data Privacy principles She also ensures the daily monitoring of Data topics (KPI monitoring, on\-site support, responses to requests) to embed the Data culture and governance rigor in daily operations.


**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Data Governance \& Data Reference Frameworks: Manage data reference frameworks (application data dictionaries) using the internal data cataloging tool (WeData – based on Collibra). You ensure comprehensive documentation of key data (shared definitions, metadata, owners) and proper alignment of technical and business frameworks.
* Modeling \& Data Lineage: Collaborate closely with project teams and the IT Data Manager to ensure the design of application data models, guaranteeing their consistency and completeness in line with business needs. You ensure documentation and maintenance of data traceability across all flows (data lineage), providing end\-to\-end visibility of every critical data point from its source to its consumption (a prerequisite for managing risks and ensuring compliance).
* Data Quality: Ensure the implementation and execution of data quality control plans defined by the business, by steering continuous improvement action plans dedicated to critical data. As an expert, you share your analyses and recommendations to improve data quality and strengthen trust in their use.
* Operational support \& continuous improvement: Supporting and raising awareness among technical and business teams on a daily basis on Data topics: training in the use of governance tools (data dictionary, data flow mapping), advice on good data management practices, and responses to specific requests. You propose solutions to continuously improve data resilience and integrity, and contribute to the optimization of governance processes.
* KPI Data Management: Contributing to the production of the Data Management Dashboard.


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Ability to drive and contribute to Data projects (quality, security, architecture, etc.) in a cross\-functional manner, in a complex environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a sense of rigor to formalize and document results (reports, traceability matrices).


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Data Modeling \& Management – Mastery of conceptual, logical, and physical data models; strong knowledge of databases and data integration technologies (ETL/ELT, data pipelines).
* Data Catalogue \& Data Lineage – Practical experience with a cataloging/metadata tool (ideally weData/Collibra or equivalent) to manage data dictionaries. Solid understanding of data lineage principles and ability to document data flow traceability.
* Data Quality \& Compliance – Knowledge of data quality standards and methods, as well as experience in implementing quality controls. Awareness of regulatory compliance issues (GDPR), data governance and security.
* Data Visualization: Hands\-on experience with a Data Visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau...)
* Excellent communication skills, able to simplify Data issues and train/evangelize various stakeholders (IT teams, business units, management).
* Team spirit and ease in collaboration with multiple players (IT Data Manager, developers, business referents, Security teams…).
* Autonomy, proactivity and ability to propose improvements to continuously enhance data governance processes.
* Strong interest in data quality and enhancement, with a strong sense of ethics and confidentiality


**Specific Qualifications**
* Minimum experience of 6 \- 9 years in a function related to data management (Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Analyst/Engineer where there is a governance dimension).
* Bachelor's Degree or Higher education (Engineer or Master 2\) in computer science, data management or related field.

EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99\.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

 Navi Mumbai (WFO) \- Malad

description:
**Experience** 



* 7\+ years of overall experience in data management / MDM / data architecture

* Strong experience with Informatica MDM or another leading MDM platform
* Experience assessing MDM architecture, data quality, integration and operating models

**Required Technical Experience** 




**Mandatory:** 



* Strong experience with Informatica MDM or another enterprise MDM platform
* Strong understanding of MDM architecture and implementation patterns
* Experience with matching, merging, survivorship and golden\-record concepts
* Strong understanding of data quality and data governance
* Experience reviewing enterprise integration architectures and data flows
* Experience with data migration, reconciliation and validation
* Experience assessing MDM operating models and stewardship processes
* Ability to analyse complex MDM implementations and identify root causes of business/data issues



**Desirable:** 



* Profisee experience
* Azure / Microsoft Fabric / Microsoft Purview
* API and integration architecture
* SAP, Salesforce, Oracle or other enterprise source/consumer systems
* Experience with MDM health checks or independent implementation reviews
* Experience in retail, FMCG, hospitality or multi\-site organisations



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Business \& Current\-State Assessment** 



* Understand the business processes dependent on master data
* Document current challenges, business impacts and manual workarounds
* Understand how master data is created, maintained, approved and consumed
* Identify key business and technology stakeholders
* Assess current data ownership, stewardship and governance arrangements



**2\. MDM Architecture Assessment** 



* Review the overall MDM architecture and solution design
* Assess the alignment between business requirements and the existing MDM implementation
* Identify unnecessary complexity, duplication or over\-engineering
* Assess MDM patterns including \- Master data domains, Golden records, Matching and deduplication, Survivorship, Hierarchies, Data stewardship, Data governance
* Assess whether the current solution is aligned to MDM best practices



**3\. Integration \& Data Flow Assessment** 



* Review the end\-to\-end data flow between source systems, MDM and downstream applications
* Analyse how master\-data changes propagate through the organisation
* Identify potential causes of incorrect downstream updates
* Review integration patterns, interfaces, APIs, batch processes and event\-driven processes
* Assess data ownership and system\-of\-record responsibilities
* Review reconciliation, monitoring, error handling and exception\-management processes
* Identify control gaps contributing to downstream business issues



**4\. Data Quality \& Migration Assessment** 



* Assess the quality and integrity of data migrated into the MDM platform
* Review migration methodology, reconciliation and validation controls
* Identify potential gaps in data profiling and cleansing
* Review DQ rules, thresholds and exception processes
* Determine whether current DQ controls are overly restrictive relative to business requirements
* Recommend a pragmatic approach to data\-quality management



**5\. MDM Operating Model** 



* Assess the current MDM support and operating model
* Review roles and responsibilities across business, IT, data stewards and support teams
* Assess governance and decision\-making processes
* Review incident and problem\-management processes
* Identify opportunities to improve operational ownership and accountability
